name: ModelVariant632_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant632_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (32 camera-facing flares (two mirrored sets for command 1) flash on a disc in front of the slot and fade, a dotted sphere grows there, and commands 0 and 3 draw a swipe trail of ten shaded strips behind two points tracked on the model over the last eleven frames); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-649 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant649_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
